item.title: Children with cancer scammed out of millions fundraised for their treatment
item.description:
📝 She was told this video would help crowdfund money for better treatment. But Aljin was told the campaign had failed, and says she received none of this money - just a $700 (£524) filming fee on the day. Aljin messaged Erez, who told her the video "wasn't successful".
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ckgz318y8elo

item.title: A linear-time alternative for Dimensionality Reduction and fast visualisation
The biggest heat pumps in the world
item.description:
📝 Refrigerants inside the heat pumps evaporate when they are warmed even slightly. By compressing the refrigerant, you boost that heat further. The Mannheim heat pump setup will cost €200m ($235m; £176m).
